description: Validate an AIDP Credential Store secret end to end: resolves it, checks the required OCI keys, builds the signer, and confirms it authenticates against AIDP (GET /catalogs). Reports pass/fail per step. Nothing written; all values masked. Run this before wiring a credential into other tools.

tools.description: Point it at a credential (display name or OCI Vault secret OCID) and it reports which checks pass: resolved, required keys present, fingerprint valid, data_lake_ocid present, signer built, authenticated.

schema.name: credential_name
schema.description: The credential to test: a SECRET_TOKEN display name (5 keys: tenancy, user, fingerprint, private_key, data_lake_ocid) or an OCI Vault secret OCID (ocid1.vaultsecret...). Falls back to conf.credential_name.

credential_name.help: Optional default if you don't pass credential_name at call time.

data_lake_ocid.help: Optional — the auth check reads data_lake_ocid from the credential bundle first, then here.

region.help: Optional — auto-derived from the data_lake_ocid region code.
